name: fractal-pointlist
description: Engineering point-list workbench: sources, data conditioning, network objects and generated outputs (customer point list, Source→MQTT configs, IP schema).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fpl/core && npm run build -w @fpl/web && npm run build -w @fpl/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fpl/core && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n db,core,api,web -c magenta,gray,blue,green "npm:db:local" "npm:dev:core" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fpl/core && npm run typecheck -w @fpl/server && npm run typecheck -w @fpl/web
scripts.dev:web: node tools/wait-url.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8080/readyz 180 "the API" && npm run dev -w @fpl/web
scripts.dev:docker: npm run build -w @fpl/core && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:noapi: npm run build -w @fpl/core && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n db,core,web -c magenta,gray,green "npm:db:local" "npm:dev:core" "npm:dev:web:now"
